useCase: Detecting AI生成的 content using global attention 模式 that capture both local and long-range 伪影
mechanism: Divides the image into 16x16 patches and processes them through a Vision Transformer encoder with multi-head self-attention. The attention mechanism captures long-range dependencies and global 模式 跨 the entire image. The [CLS] token output feeds into a classification head for real/AI determination.
name: 视觉变换器 (ViT) 检测
source: Dosovitskiy et al. (2021) - An Image is Worth 16x16 Words, ICLR; adapted for forensics by Cocchi et al. (2023)
parameters: Patch size: 16x16, Hidden dim: 768, Attention heads: 12, Layers: 12, Input: 224x224, 分类: MLP head on [CLS] token
description: 使用 Vision Transformer architecture to capture long-range dependencies图像中的. ViT excels at detecting subtle global 模式 that CNNs may miss in AI生成的 content.

references.title: Dosovitskiy, A. et al. (2021). An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale. ICLR.
Cocchi, F. et al. (2023). Unveiling the Impact of Image Transformations on Deepfake Detection. Image and Vision Computing.

strengths:
• 通过自注意力捕获全局图像上下文
• 出色的跨生成器泛化能力
• 注意力图提供可解释性
• 随更大数据集良好扩展
limitations:
• Requires significant computational resources
• Large model size and memory footprint
• Needs large training datasets for optimal performance
• Patch-based approach may miss sub-patch 伪影
